title: Run a fresh blinded holdout for the frozen FTS5 memory index
description: Evaluate the frozen TASK-259 temporal-safe SQLite FTS5/BM25 plus reciprocal-rank-fusion retriever on a fresh completed-task corpus not used by TASK-257 or TASK-258. Freeze a generic packet/scoring harness before truth authoring. Use a fresh visible read-only author to create heterogeneous paraphrased questions with at least two compound cases and three legitimate no-match cases, then a different fresh visible read-only evaluator receiving one compact packet at a time. Score task/source precision and recall, compound completeness, false-positive abstention behavior, context, latency, path/temporal warnings, and a task-only ablation. Do not change the frozen retriever or integrate it into startup, routing, UI, canonical authority, or external services.
acceptance_criteria: The TASK-259 retriever hash remains frozen, and the generic validation/rendering/scoring harness plus focused tests are frozen before the independent author creates truth.

A fresh visible read-only author uses only completed TASK-206 through TASK-249 records and their registered outputs, excluding non-completed TASK-236, to create at least eight positive questions, two compound task sets, and three legitimate no-match questions across at least five work areas.

A different fresh visible read-only evaluator receives one bounded packet at a time and does not access the truth, combined packet, index, task files, source files, research, prior experiments, or repository search.

The final report compares frozen FTS task/source metrics, evaluator precision/recall, compound completion, task-only ablation, no-match false positives, context, latency, path/temporal warnings, and limitations without making an adoption or integration claim.
